info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscribe API allows users to remove their subscriptions to weather alerts, enhancing user control over notifications. By utilizing this endpoint, consumers can efficiently manage their preferences regarding weather information. This API primarily serves users who wish to opt-out of receiving weather alerts, ensuring a personalized experience. It is particularly useful for applications that engage with users to keep them informed about severe weather while allowing them to customize their alert settings.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from specific alerts they no longer wish to receive. By calling this operation, users can effectively manage their alert preferences and reduce unwanted notifications.

requestBody.description: The request body for the unsubscribe operation used to remove an alert subscription. This body must contain all required fields to properly identify the alert to be unsubscribed from.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for unsubscribing from alerts.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the unsubscribe operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the unsubscribe request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the unsubscribe operation.

state.description: Current state of the unsubscribe operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the unsubscribe request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for successful unsubscribe operation.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the unsubscribe request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the unsubscribe request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe action was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the unsubscribe operation.

x-processing-time.description: This header indicates the total time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of '0' indicates that the request was processed instantaneously.
